papers.abstract: Omics studies often produce tables with thousands to tens of thousands of molecular features and few samples. Tabular foundation models use diverse strategies to predict labels for such tables, with some relying on in-context learning, while approaches to wide tables may involve subsampling, grouping, or compressing features. We present TabOmics, a small, open family of tabular foundation models with 7.3M parameters, pretrained exclusively on synthetic tables. TabOmics processes all features retained after preprocessing jointly and derives predictions, attention-derived feature-importance scores, and test sample embeddings from the same forward pass. On 46 classification tasks from three benchmarks of high-dimensional, low-sample-size tables, TabOmics v2.5 with eight ensemble members achieves the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) among the evaluated models (0.943), outperforming TabPFN-3.5 with eight members on 32 tasks despite having about 30 times fewer parameters. With a single member, TabOmics v2.5 reaches a mean AUROC of 0.941, versus 0.942 for TabPFN-3.5 with eight members, with no significant paired difference under the reported task-level analysis. On synthetic tables, its feature-importance scores achieve feature recovery similar to that of TabPFN-Wide, and its predictions remain above chance at 30,000 features. On breast cancer tasks, the top ranked genes include PAM50 genes, which define the subtype labels, indicating concordance with the label definition rather than independent biological validation. The code, model weights, training recipes, and experimental artifacts are publicly available.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TabOmics，一个仅 730 万参数、仅用合成表预训练的小型开放表格基础模型，在宽组学数据分类任务上以更少参数达到与 TabPFN-3.5 相当或更优的平均 AUROC。
summary.methods: 预训练仅用合成表格，联合处理预处理后保留的全部特征，并从同一次前向传播得到预测、注意力特征重要性与测试样本嵌入。在三个基准的 46 个高维低样本分类任务上评估，含八成员集成与单成员设置。
summary.relevance: 针对宽组学数据的表格基础模型，涉及组学表型预测与预训练策略，对应“预训练”主题。
summary.caveat: 特征重要性在乳腺癌任务中排名靠前的基因含 PAM50 基因，摘要明确指出这反映与标签定义一致而非独立生物学验证；评估集中于三个基准的 46 项任务，AUROC 以各自任务级分析报告，跨基准外推性未详述。

papers.title: Causals: An Open Knowledge Graph for Research on Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Applying causal knowledge to a new event requires connecting the event to relevant entities and the relationships through which its consequences may unfold. We present Causals, an open knowledge graph for research on this form of reasoning. Its initial release, constructed from news reports, contains 369,184 nodes and 1,272,418 edges linking reported events, organizations, commodities, financial instruments, and other entities. Structural relationships, observations, and attributed causal claims retain distinct semantics and links to source records. We describe the construction and representation of the resource and characterize its connectivity and multi-hop retrieval properties. Causals provides shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply mechanisms to particular events. The dataset is available under CC BY 4.0 at https://causals.org/, and we invite contributions to its ontology, records, and evidence.

summary.takeaway: 提出Causals开放知识图谱，用于研究将因果知识关联到具体事件并推理其后果的机制。
summary.methods: 从新闻报道构建，含369,184个节点和1,272,418条边，区分结构关系、观察与归因因果声明并链接源记录；刻画连通性与多跳检索特性。
summary.relevance: 直接面向知识图谱主题，为语言模型检索相关上下文并应用因果机制提供共享关系知识。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出因果推理任务的定量评测结果，初始版本仅基于新闻来源，覆盖范围有限。

papers.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
papers.abstract: Recommender systems, which retrieve items of interest to users based on their interaction histories, have recently witnessed several key technological advancements, benefiting from the semantic representation space and model-data scaling. Nevertheless, practitioners and researchers have frequently encountered critical inconsistencies between simple offline evaluations and complex online results, and this gap still exists in the era of large models. In this work, we address several key factors that contribute to this inconsistency: 1) the \textit{large-scale continual learning challenge} that assumes a practical demand to maintain long-term model effectiveness under dynamic item pools and distributional shifts; 2) the \textit{combinatorial diversity challenge} that requires the generation strategy to solve the accuracy-diversity trade-off in both the finer token level and the holistic item level; and 3) the \textit{multi-task reward balancing challenge}, which is particularly critical for modern generative models that can accurately model the sequence distribution but are less controllable for the multi-task demands. To address these challenges and further pave the way for the development of more realistic recommendation solutions, we introduce KuaiRecV2, a deliberately constructed benchmark with industrial-level datasets from Kuaishou. Specifically, we provide a large-scale interaction dataset with million-scale multi-modal item information and long-term interaction records across 30 days, with a dynamic video candidate pool. Additionally, we provide a rigorous benchmark that evaluates retrieval accuracy, diversity, and multi-task performance in one rubric system, where an effective advancement occurs if and only if the new method improves all metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/cxli2333/KuaiRecV2

summary.takeaway: 发布KuaiRecV2基准，用工业级数据考察动态物品池下的持续学习、组合多样性与多任务奖励平衡。
summary.methods: 基于快手数据，含百万级多模态物品信息与30天长期交互记录及动态视频候选池；构建统一评测检索准确性、多样性和多任务的严格基准。
summary.relevance: 与持续学习主题相关，强调分布漂移和动态物品池下维持长期模型有效性的实际需求。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体基线结果或数值，基准结论需参考原文。

papers.title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is a widely used regularization-based technique for continual learning, protecting performance on old tasks with a quadratic penalty whose empirical Fisher is usually justified through probabilistic curvature. We instead introduce Continual Learning as an Optimization Constraint (CLOC): new training must preserve chosen functionals of learned behavior. EWC's empirical Fisher is exactly the first-order form of this constraint when the preserved functional is each sample's loss. This derivation exposes a flaw: EWC implicitly weights each sample by the scale of its loss gradient, so well-fitted samples lose importance. EWC-DR observed this failure in classification; CLOC identifies its general cause. Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation (IEWC) penalizes output changes according to the first-order approximation of each old sample's loss level set, removing the weighting for any differentiable loss and output geometry, and prevents corrupt samples from dominating the importance matrix. Across classification, segmentation, language, forecasting, and diffusion, IEWC variants match or improve on EWC and outperform EWC-DR. In a held-out evaluation with validation-selected hyperparameters, uniform IEWC improves ImageNet-R accuracy over matched EWC by 2.00 percentage points (95% CI 0.93-3.07).

summary.takeaway: 将持续学习表述为优化约束（CLOC），揭示EWC按损失梯度尺度加权样本的缺陷，并提出IEWC。
summary.methods: 推导EWC经验Fisher为一阶约束形式；IEWC按旧样本损失水平集的一阶近似惩罚输出变化；在分类、分割、语言、预测和扩散任务上评测。
summary.relevance: 直接改进持续学习中的正则化方法EWC，属于该主题核心问题。
summary.caveat: 主要提升幅度仅在ImageNet-R上报出（2.00个百分点，95% CI 0.93–3.07），其他任务为匹配或改进的定性描述。

papers.title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction and Robust Evidence Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
papers.abstract: Retrieving evidence from Indian Knowledge Systems is complicated by transliteration variants, ambiguous names, and relations distributed across passages. We present an ontology-guided knowledge graph (KG) pipeline that links typed entities and relations extracted with Qwen3-32B to original textual evidence. Retrieval combines sense-aware grounding, bounded graph traversal, lexical anchors, relationship-vector search, and passage reranking. We evaluate KG alone, single-vector retrieval (SV), and KG unions with SV and Entity Notes on 320 questions from Dhara Bench, matching the per-question candidate count across internal systems under BGE and Qwen rerankers. Standalone KG has the highest Precision@5 under both rerankers and the highest MRR@20 in Counting, Composite, and Multi-hop among the evaluated internal configurations. With Qwen, KG achieves Multi-hop MRR@20 of 0.8722, compared with 0.7622 for the fully reranked KG + SV union. The KG + SV + Entity Notes union instead provides the highest overall Recall@20 (0.5134), compared with 0.4347 for KG. On the 15 Multi-hop questions, Qwen KG achieves complete-evidence MRR@20 of 0.4651 versus 0.3372 for SV, while both full unions complete ten questions within twenty results compared with nine for KG. Gemini 3.7 Flash, evaluated through manually reviewed source mappings, re mains stronger on overall MRR and nDCG, while internal systems have category-specific advantages. All comparisons are descriptive. A separate deployment timing study measures mean retrieval times of 20.374 s for KG and 0.646 s for SV. The findings support selecting KG or its unions according to the required balance of early relevance, evidence completeness, and retrieval cost.

summary.takeaway: 提出本体引导的知识图谱构建与稳健证据检索流程，用于印度知识体系问答。
summary.methods: 用Qwen3-32B抽取类型化实体与关系并链接原文证据；检索结合语义感知 grounding、有界图遍历、词法锚点、关系向量搜索与段落重排；在Dhara Bench 320题上比较KG、单向量检索及并集。
summary.relevance: 知识图谱主题，聚焦图谱构建与多跳证据检索。
summary.caveat: 作者明确所有比较为描述性；KG平均检索耗时20.374秒远高于单向量检索0.646秒，且Gemini 3.7 Flash在整体MRR和nDCG上仍更强。

papers.title: SPIRE: Task-agnostic embodied continual learning through autonomous situation inference and causal motor-primitive reuse
papers.abstract: Embodied continual learning requires controllers to infer changing situations, retain prior behavior and reuse motor skills without task labels or known boundaries. The challenge is deciding when to recover earlier behavior and which skills can support new learning. We introduce Situation-guided Primitive Integration for Recurrent Embodiment (SPIRE), a recurrent-spiking system that infers latent contexts from action-outcome evidence and learns context-specific motor actors online. Mature actors become protected sources that combine with a target-context residual to drive recurrent-spiking motor populations. Across coordinate, three-joint and hidden-force control, SPIRE maintained control, autonomously inferred situations, retained prior behavior and accelerated acquisition of an unseen source composition, reducing mean interactions to criterion by approximately 40% relative to matched fresh controllers. Rewinding compatible source actors impaired early acquisition in every matched intervention, demonstrating causal reuse. Against seven recurrent continual-learning and modular-control comparators, SPIRE achieved 2.4 times the mean prior-learning advantage of the strongest eligible task-free alternative selected for each paired stream. These results demonstrate autonomous recovery and causal reuse of motor skills for new learning in continuous embodied control.

summary.takeaway: 提出SPIRE，通过自主情境推断和因果运动基元复用实现无任务标签的具身持续学习。
summary.methods: 循环脉冲系统从动作-结果证据推断潜在情境并在线学习情境特定运动actor；在坐标、三关节和隐力控制任务上与七种循环持续学习及模块化控制方法比较。
summary.relevance: 持续学习主题，关注无任务边界下的技能保留与复用。
summary.caveat: 评测限于仿真控制任务，摘要未说明真实机器人部署验证。

papers.title: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
papers.abstract: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.

summary.takeaway: 将持续学习用于面部表情识别（CLIFER）以实现人机谈判中的个性化情感感知。
summary.methods: 异步架构在实时交互中后台更新CLIFER，差分反馈把效价-唤醒变化转成智能体目标效用调整；66名参与者的被试内实验与人形机器人谈判。
summary.relevance: 持续学习主题，展示个性化情感模型的在线适应应用。
summary.caveat: 单一人形机器人实验环境，样本66人；参与者效用与Nash距离在条件间无显著变化。

papers.title: Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Unipolar neurons are the predominant type of nerve cell in the octopus and in most other invertebrates. A single neurite (a fiber extending from the cell body) branches into a tree that carries both input and output synapses. The branches send graded local outputs to nearby cells, and one site on the main neurite sends a global output to distant targets. This paper proposes a network of such neurons and a learning rule for it. Each neuron is modeled as a tree of passive segments, whose activations are computed exactly as the steady state of a linear system. The network learns from reward alone, with a rule called recirculation. After each forward pass, a second pass sends requested changes of the outputs back through the same connections. Each synapse then adjusts its weight using only quantities available at its own location. Because the system of each neuron is symmetric, this update closely follows the gradient of the error in the predicted reward. Two mechanisms limit forgetting when tasks are learned in sequence: a task code inhibits a different subset of branches in each task, while consolidation lowers the learning rate of synapses that changed strongly in the recent past. The model is evaluated on a sequence of MNIST and Iris tasks. The network maintains high accuracy with low forgetting, whereas gradient-based training of the same network forgets earlier tasks almost completely.

summary.takeaway: 提出由recirculation规则训练的类章鱼单极神经元网络，用于基于奖励的持续学习并抑制遗忘。
summary.methods: 神经元建模为无源分段树，激活按线性系统稳态精确计算；通过回传输出变化请求的二次前向传播做局部权重更新；用任务编码抑制不同分支并结合突触巩固；在MNIST与Iris任务序列上评测。
summary.relevance: 持续学习主题，探索非梯度、局部学习规则下的遗忘抑制。
summary.caveat: 评测仅限MNIST和Iris等小规模任务序列，摘要未报告与主流持续学习方法的系统比较。

papers.title: Disruption of cell-type-specific molecular programs of striatal spiny projection neurons in autism.
papers.abstract: Rare genetic variants contribute substantially to autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet the regulatory logic of vulnerable subcortical cells is poorly understood. In a 16p11.2 deletion mouse model, lineage tracing across five brain regions revealed prominent striatal changes. In the human putamen from ASD and neurotypical donors, single-nucleus multi-omics showed transcriptional alterations concentrated in D1 striosome spiny projection neurons (SPNs), affecting synaptic and energy metabolism genes, with altered synapse-supporting programs in astrocytes. Gene regulatory network analysis integrating chromatin accessibility and expression identified EGR1 and EGR3 as key regulators of these programs, with reduced activity in D1 striosome SPNs. Deleting EGR1 or EGR3 in human striatal organoids produced partially overlapping transcriptional changes. These findings establish the striatum as a site of molecular convergence in ASD and provide a multi-omic resource for dissecting subcortical mechanisms.

summary.takeaway: 揭示自闭症中纹状体D1纹质体投射神经元的细胞类型特异性分子程序紊乱，并识别EGR1/EGR3为关键调控因子。
summary.methods: 16p11.2缺失小鼠模型的跨五脑区谱系追踪；ASD与神经典型供者壳核的单核多组学；整合染色质可及性与表达构建基因调控网络；在人纹状体类器官中敲除EGR1或EGR3验证。
summary.relevance: 与GRN/Regulon主题相关，通过多组学整合识别调控这些程序的转录调控因子。
summary.caveat: 小鼠模型与人类样本结论需进一步在更多供者与体内环境中验证；类器官敲除仅产生部分重叠的转录变化。

papers.title: The road ahead for stem cell therapies in type 1 diabetes.
papers.abstract: AIMS: Type 1 diabetes results from autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic β-cells. Although exogenous insulin remains the standard treatment, it does not restore physiological glucose regulation. Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into β-cells offers a scalable alternative to cadaveric islet transplantation and has progressed rapidly over the past decade, resulting in nine clinical trials at various stages of completion. Despite this progress, durable graft function remains constrained by two major challenges: the absence of key islet microenvironment components, such as vasculature, extracellular matrix and supporting cell types and continued vulnerability to autoimmune and alloimmune rejection. METHODS & RESULTS: This review considers emerging technological approaches to overcome these barriers. Bioengineered niches, including multilineage organoids, functionalized hydrogels, decellularized matrices and bioprinting, aim to recreate the native islet microenvironment, while synthetic biology approaches, such as hypoimmune gene editing, CRISPR-based transcriptional control and stimulus-responsive survival circuits, seek to enhance grafts' resilience. Computational and single-cell approaches, including gene regulatory network analysis and digital twin frameworks, are beginning to provide predictive tools for benchmarking differentiation quality and forecasting graft outcomes. CONCLUSION: Together, these complementary strategies, potentially tailored to individual patients, represent a realistic path towards safer, more effective and durable β-cell replacement therapies for type 1 diabetes.
papers.venue: Diabetic medicine : a journal of the British Diabetic Association
